title: kithd: TLS with rustls, self-signed cert on first run
description: Create kithd::tls module. Add rcgen=0.13 and tokio-rustls=0.26 to workspace Cargo.toml and kithd Cargo.toml. load_or_generate_cert(cert_path, key_path): if both files exist, load as DER bytes; otherwise generate self-signed via rcgen::CertificateParams::new(['kith.local']), serialize cert+key as DER, write to data_dir with key file chmod 0o600, return (Vec<CertificateDer>, PrivateKeyDer). make_tls_acceptor(cert_path, key_path): call load_or_generate_cert, build rustls::ServerConfig with with_no_client_auth().with_single_cert(), wrap in tokio_rustls::TlsAcceptor. TlsError enum: Io, Rcgen, Rustls variants. Never log key bytes. pub mod tls added to lib.rs.
